user.title: Connect to a USB/IP server
user.description: Enter the address of the USBAnywhere or usbipd server the Neat ADF scanner is shared from.

reconfigure.title: Change the scanner address
reconfigure.description: Use this when the phone got a new IP address, for example after a new router or internet provider.

menu_options.reconfigure_scan: Search the network for the scanner

error.no_devices: The server is not sharing any USB devices
error.dir_not_allowed: This directory is not allowed. Add it to allowlist_external_dirs.
error.not_found: No scanner was found on the network. Check the phone is on the same Wi-Fi and USBAnywhere is sharing the scanner, or enter the address.

data.monitor: Watch paper, cover and button (keeps the scanner connected)
data.scan_on_button: Scan when the scanner button is pressed
data.split_sheets: Split a stack into one page per sheet (turn off to keep it as a single page)

error.dir_not_allowed: This directory is not allowed. Add it to allowlist_external_dirs.

scan.name: Scan
scan.description: Scan all pages in the document feeder and save them.

format.name: File format
format.description: png, jpeg or a single multipage pdf.

sheets.name: Maximum sheets
sheets.description: Scan up to this many sheets from the feeder; stops earlier when the feeder is empty.

auto_crop.name: Auto crop
auto_crop.description: Crop each page to the paper area.

duplex.name: Double-sided
duplex.description: Scan both sides of each sheet (up to 300 dpi); the front page is followed by the back page.

calibrate.name: Calibrate
calibrate.description: Scan a blank white letter-size sheet to measure the white level of every sensor column, so the left and right regions of later scans match.

export_calibration.name: Export calibration
export_calibration.description: Save the software calibration to a JSON file so it can be restored later or used on another installation.

path.name: File
path.description: Default: neat_scanner_calibration.json in the save directory. The directory must be allowed in allowlist_external_dirs.

import_calibration.name: Import calibration
import_calibration.description: Load a calibration file written by Export calibration.
